authority: Retrospective campaign developments established in revision 68 under the player’s request to resolve the elapsed expedition year. These are new authorial background decisions, not recovered transcript events, independent canon claims or historical-source discoveries.
knowledge: Archive knowledge is not automatic character knowledge. Regional public developments can appear in newspapers and correspondence; exact returns and unreceived NPC statements require delivery. No new encounter, briefing, player choice or journey is inserted into the exact transcript.
accounting: All listed national repairs, replacement deliveries, routine losses and administrative programmes are within the ordinary defence, public-works and mortality envelopes already used for the elapsed-year estimates. Do not charge their costs or ordinary deaths again. No exceptional demographic adjustment, supplementary appropriation, new debt transaction or blanket price index is posted. Individual casualty returns remain uncertain. Large future losses outside these envelopes need a separate reconciliation.
military_basis: Opening figures are preserved national-register.json estimates. Movements below reconcile that return to 11/10/0068. Accepted_or_restored includes new deliveries and return from repair; withdrawn_or_lost includes scrapping, combat loss and unserviceable workshop withdrawal, not necessarily destruction. These are rounded campaign planning estimates, not serial-number audits. Unchanged totals mean no material net change established after turnover, not a year without activity. Personnel establishments and coarse 1–5 ratings are retained unless a dated change is explicitly listed.

conflicts.effects: Fewer duplicate inspections and more predictable water notices help participating commerce. The protocol creates neither a restored federation nor a common treasury or army.
conflicts.trend: Practical cooperation increased; core claims remain.

conflicts.situation: Month 6 road-levy refusals and common-pasture petitions led to a Month 9 interim order suspending disputed levies in petitioning districts pending a mixed inquiry. Communities pursue differing aims and are not collectively rebels.
conflicts.effects: Export shipping continues and mainland firms retain advantages. The temporary concession has reduced immediate pressure in the affected districts without resolving leases or colonial inequality.
conflicts.trend: A limited concession, not independence or an organised insurgency.

conflicts.situation: On 12/04/0068 Hunters struck an outlying Veylac industrial relay and repair depot; on 03/07/0068 another attack destroyed a remote Haldrevik repair shed and stores. These local attacks were followed by dispersed repairs and duplicated records. Deaths, injuries and missing persons were reported but reliable consolidated counts have not reached this register.
conflicts.effects: Veylac restored principal relay service in Month 5; the Haldrevik site resumed basic work in Month 8 using replacement machinery. Lost skill, equipment and records still constrain recovery. Neither attack is a new major culling or a planetary casualty percentage.
conflicts.trend: Local destruction and recovery continue; no evidence here of Culling 44.
conflicts.travel: No sustained closure of an atlas trunk route is established by these developments. Local interruptions concern feeder works and inspections; the prepared expedition completed its actual services and seasonal passages. Future transport decisions require fresh local notices.
conflicts.loss_treatment: Ordinary ongoing-theatre attrition and local raid mortality are inside the baseline planning envelope, not additional deductions. Exact deaths, injuries, captures and displacement remain separately unquantified.

domestic.title: Pumping works: authorised stage completed
domestic.outcome: Cevrane supervised the second authorised replacement stage, placed in service on 04/04/0068. Uphill pressure controls passed operating acceptance on 10/06/0068. Two replacement stages now operate beside retained older sections; remaining network extensions await further budget decisions. Reduced breakdowns support Galahad’s engineering reputation. No new fee is due under the superseded commission.
domestic.delivery: Cevrane has an operating report for Savel’s follow-up packet; no new conversation or receipt by Galahad is assumed.

domestic.title: Collegium: teaching and duplicate archives
domestic.outcome: Savel maintained the teaching programme, catalogued incoming expedition duplicates and circulated civil-engineering extracts to relevant faculty. Returned official volumes can now be checked against those earlier packets. Private cipher research was not among the material available to him.
domestic.delivery: Academic follow-up is to arrive through Savel, as already arranged after the return debriefing.

domestic.title: Serravonne: maintenance and apprenticeship
domestic.outcome: Vardesca’s railway staff added repeatable inspection checks from the earlier workshop work to normal maintenance and apprentice instruction. The railway remains in operation; Veskan has resumed ordinary duties after recovery. No resignation, retirement, new pension or salary amount is assigned.
domestic.delivery: Vardesca and Veskan can describe these changes on Galahad’s planned visit; the maintenance update does not enact that visit.

domestic.title: Dorlac: consignment reconciled
domestic.outcome: The previously uncounted departure remainder is reconciled as five charms. Dorlac sold four during the expedition at 20 lorrats each: 80 gross, her agreed quarter share 20, and 60 due to Galahad. One charm remains unsold. Lifetime sales are now 47. She holds the 60 pending settlement and accepts enquiries rather than prepaid orders for unavailable stock.
domestic.delivery: The merchant’s account is prepared for delivery, not yet paid to Galahad. Personal cash stays 1,197; the separate 60-lorrat receivable is not spendable cash.

domestic.title: Older arts: new cases and limited teaching
domestic.outcome: Orchant has begun keeping separate observation notes for one newly manifesting local pupil and two uncertain referrals, emphasising mental boundaries and resistance to intrusive impulses. Other schools increasingly exchange cautious case letters. This is neither a reliable world census nor a planetary protection system; training demand is outpacing experienced teachers.
domestic.delivery: Orchant’s observations remain hers until shared. No new Order recruit, character encounter, possession or automatic protective ability is assigned.

domestic.title: Estate: completed maintenance and settled operations
domestic.outcome: Corva and Lucette completed the repairs and first furniture purchases already recorded in the return statement, coordinated seasonal labour and kept the house supplied. The workshop is dry, secure and lit; equipment remains unpurchased. The actual 162 operating surplus is already included in the 314 estate balance.
domestic.delivery: This household statement has already been received; do not credit the surplus or charge the repairs again.

consignment.knowledge: Prepared merchant account; not yet delivered or paid. Newly reconciled background stock, not an additional historic cash receipt.
